query: What is Nubank's most recently reported number of customers, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Nubank reported 143 million customers globally as of the third quarter ending September 30, 2026 [1]. Regarding its workforce, the company reported 10,027 employees as of the 2025 reporting period [2]. Recent professional networking data indicates the company currently employs 12,755 people [3].
